visual_action: A young Black woman stands on a city sidewalk holding a sign that reads 'REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS ARE ON THE BALLOT.' She wears an 'I Voted' sticker. The video then cuts to a young Latina woman on a different sidewalk, also holding a sign that first reads 'I WILL VOTE.COM' and then flips to show 'REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS ARE ON THE BALLOT.' Both women are smiling.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official '@democrats' account and promotes voting on the issue of reproductive rights, a key platform for the party.

cast.name: unnamed supporter 1
cast.evidence: A young Black woman featured in the first half of the video holding a sign.

cast.name: unnamed supporter 2
cast.evidence: A young Latina woman featured in the second half of the video holding a sign.

on_screen_text.text: REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS ARE ON THE BALLOT

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: An upbeat, electronic dance track ('swamp skonster x fortnite moves — bloomin') plays throughout the video, creating an energetic and youthful tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of two main shots of different people, with a quick cut between them. The first shot includes a fast transition to a selfie-view.
cultural_references: The music is titled 'swamp skonster x fortnite moves', referencing the popular online video game Fortnite and its associated dance trends.
central_claim: Voters must turn out to protect reproductive rights, which are at stake in the current election.
intended_effect: To energize and mobilize voters, especially young people, to vote by focusing on the issue of reproductive rights.
